entities.name: Tsuyoshi Nishioka

entities.summary: Tsuyoshi Nishioka  is a Japanese former professional baseball infielder. He played in Nippon Professional Baseball (NPB) for the Chiba Lotte Marines and Hanshin Tigers, and in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Minnesota Twins.
